name: block public off
title: Allow public bucket policy
diff:
diff --git a/infra/s3.tf b/infra/s3.tf
--- a/infra/s3.tf
+++ b/infra/s3.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  block_public_policy = true
+  block_public_policy = false

name: priv escalation
title: Allow privilege escalation
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/api.yaml b/k8s/api.yaml
--- a/k8s/api.yaml
+++ b/k8s/api.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
+          allowPrivilegeEscalation: true

title: Add DB password to env file

name: rds public
title: Make DB reachable
diff:
diff --git a/infra/db.tf b/infra/db.tf
--- a/infra/db.tf
+++ b/infra/db.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  publicly_accessible = false
+  publicly_accessible = true

name: deletion protection

diff:

--- a/infra/db.tf

+  deletion_protection = false
